mapper.insert: INSERT INTO predict_record (user_id, model_id, file_url, input_text, predict_result, confidence, duration, create_time, original_filename) VALUES (#{userId}, #{modelId}, #{fileUrl}, #{inputText}, #{predictResult}, #{confidence}, #{duration}, #{createTime}, #{originalFilename})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, model_id, file_url, input_text, predict_result, confidence, duration, create_time, original_filename FROM predict_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(create_time, '2000-01-01 00:00:00') DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM predict_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE predict_record SET create_time = '2000-01-01 00:00:00' WHERE create_time IS NULL
